basics.name: Clark Tomlinson
basics.label: Frontend Software Architect
basics.summary: Frontend architect and full-stack engineer. I set technical direction for large front-end codebases — standards, tooling, build systems, and the migration paths that get teams off legacy platforms without stopping feature work. Comfortable everywhere from a React render loop to a Go service to a Terraform module, and happiest solving problems at a scale where the simple answer stops working.
